subject: Nuova Health MAP kickoff and CS handoff
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nuovahealth.com>
Cc: Sophie Tang <sophie.tang@nuovahealth.com>, procurement@nuovahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Nuova Health MAP kickoff and CS handoff

Hi Alex and Sophie —

Thanks again for signing the SOW — excited to partner with Nuova Health. Per our mutual action plan (attached), next phase is a short MAP kickoff to align owners, timelines, and success criteria so we can start onboarding as soon as next week.

Introducing Monica Patel (cc) who will be your Customer Success lead. Monica will run the onboarding, coordinate technical touchpoints, and own the success milestones in the MAP. Monica — Alex and Sophie are the primary stakeholders on your side; Alex will lead the clinical evaluation track, Sophie is the IT project lead.

High-level proposed MAP milestones (see attached for details):
- Week 0: Kickoff call and account access
- Week 1–2: Evaluation deployment (staging) and baseline metrics
- Week 3: Pilot run with 2 clinical workflows
- Week 4: Quality signoff and go-live readiness

Open items for the kickoff:
1) Confirm internal owners and secondary contacts at Nuova
2) Agree on preferred weekly cadence for status updates (30m check-ins vs weekly reports)
3) Identify any compliance evidence Nuova needs flagged for procurement

Attachments: Nuova_MAP_v1.pdf (MAP draft) and SOW_Nuova_2026_signed.pdf (signed SOW).

Proposed times for kickoff this week: Wed 4/14 10:00–10:30 PT, Thu 4/15 08:00–08:30 PT, Fri 4/16 11:00–11:30 PT. Please let us know what works.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nuovahealth.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Tang <sophie.tang@nuovahealth.com>, procurement@nuovahealth.com
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Nuova Health MAP kickoff and CS handoff

Hi Jasmine —

Appreciate the intro and congrats team. Monica, great to meet you.

High level: Nuova is ready to move quickly on a focused evaluation. Confirming internal owners:
- Clinical lead: Dr. Emily Park (emily.park@nuovahealth.com) — will validate workflows
- IT lead: Sophie Tang (cc) — infra & access
- Procurement: procurement@nuovahealth.com — handling the SOW paperwork

We prefer Wed 4/14 10:00 PT for the kickoff. For cadence, 30-minute weekly syncs work best for the first month. For evidence, procurement will want our SOC 2 and data retention policy — we have a short questionnaire they may send over by EOD tomorrow.

One ask: can you include a short acceptance checklist in the MAP that maps to our clinical signoff criteria? That will help our stakeholders.

See you on Wednesday — I’ll send calendar invites from our side.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Director, Clinical Programs
Nuova Health
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nuovahealth.com>, Sophie Tang <sophie.tang@nuovahealth.com>, procurement@nuovahealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 07:30:00 -0700
Subject: INTERNAL: Nuova Health MAP kickoff — handoff and immediate next steps

Team — following Alex's reply, kickoff confirmed for Wed 4/14 10:00 PT. Quick handoff notes so Monica and Neha have context before the call: 

- Customer: Nuova Health (RDW-2026-NUOVA-01). Signed SOW attached.
- Primary contacts: Alex Rivera (clinical), Sophie Tang (IT), procurement@nuovahealth.com. Secondary: Dr. Emily Park (clinical reviewer).
- Goals: complete staging evaluation and pilot within 4 weeks, get clinical signoff on two workflows.
- Risk items flagged by customer: SOC 2 evidence and data retention policy — procurement may send questionnaire tonight.

Monica — can you lead the kickoff and confirm the meeting agenda? Suggested agenda: intros (5m), MAP walkthrough & owners (10m), staging access checklist (5m), success metrics & acceptance criteria (5m), next steps & calendar (5m).

Neha — please have the staging access checklist and the temporary API keys flow ready to discuss (we may need an SRE on the call if there are IAM questions). Evelyn — please prepare the onboarding timeline slide that maps to the MAP milestones and acceptance checklist Alex requested.

I’ve attached the latest MAP draft (Nuova_MAP_v1.pdf) and the signed SOW. I’ll stay on the call for the first 15 minutes.

Thanks — Jasmine
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nuovahealth.com>, Sophie Tang <sophie.tang@nuovahealth.com>, procurement@nuovahealth.com
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nuova Health MAP kickoff — handoff and immediate next steps

Thanks, Jasmine. Confirming I’ll run the kickoff. Agenda looks good — I added a 5-minute block to confirm acceptance checklist items with Alex and Dr. Park.

Immediate next steps (Monica):
- 4/14 kickoff (10:00 PT) — run agenda, capture owners and acceptance checklist
- 4/15–4/22 — staging deployment support (Neha to lead tech tasks)
- 4/22 — pilot run begin; weekly 30m check-ins (Wednesdays)

I’ll upload the acceptance checklist to the shared Drive folder and send a follow-up note with owners and the calendar invites. If procurement’s questionnaire arrives, I’ll loop in Security & Compliance.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
